A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RL-ZVP research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–G are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v2 reports original model-training experiments, benchmark results, ablations, training dynamics, and qualitative outputs in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds results for Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct in Appendix B.3 and Table 8.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and the entropy-guided advantage and objective formulations remain unchanged. The Llama experiment applies the existing method without introducing an algorithmic or architectural modification.

E1.justification: Training coverage remains MATH, DAPO-Math-17k, and NuminaMath-CoT, with the same six math benchmarks and four out-of-domain benchmark suites. The Llama addition changes the model configuration, not the data or task requirements.

E2.justification: The existing comparisons retain their comparator membership. New Table 8 reuses GRPO, GRPO-DS-r/g, and GRESO-r/g; it introduces no new comparison method.

E3.justification: Appendix B.3 adds evaluation using a 3B instruction-tuned Llama model under the stated existing setup. Separately, Table 5 changes Qwen3-1.7B-Base learning-rate warmup from 4 to 10 steps. This is a reported setting revision; the PDFs do not establish that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Appendix B.3 adds a model-family generalization check, testing whether RL-ZVP's effectiveness extends beyond Qwen to Llama. The component, alpha-sensitivity, and symmetric-advantage ablations, training-dynamics analyses, prompt statistics, and qualitative cases are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports training seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added Llama table follows the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: New Table 8 reports Llama results: RL-ZVP versus GRPO reaches 17.08 versus 14.58 AIME24 Acc@8, but 70.46 versus 71.08 MATH500 Pass@8. These are additional model-setting results. Existing benchmark and ablation values, plotted results, and qualitative outputs remain unchanged after matching relocated material.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations, gradient derivation, Remarks 1–3, and symmetric-variant Equation (8) are retained. Equation-reference formatting changes do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The central contribution and claims about learning from zero-variance prompts and outperforming GRPO and filtering baselines remain. The conclusion removes repeated numerical maxima, but those headline claims remain in the abstract and results.

C2.justification: Appendix B.3 newly interprets the Llama results as evidence of generalization across pretraining and alignment characteristics. Section 6 adds future directions involving non-zero-variance prompts and combinations with existing token-level shaping methods. The 8B-scale and binary-reward limitations remain.

D1.justification: Table 5 revises the documented small-model warmup from 4 to 10 steps. Appendix B.3 names the added Llama model and states reuse of the experimental setup, without a separate detailed configuration. Existing hardware, framework, and project-access disclosures remain.

R1.justification: v3 adds Grattafiori et al.'s Llama reference for Appendix B.3. The remaining bibliography changes principally update publication metadata, shorten author lists, and consolidate duplicate Qwen3 entries; the positioning against prior RL and prompt-filtering methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized edits to the abstract, motivation, and conclusion, adds subsection B.3, revises funding acknowledgments, updates conference headers, and standardizes bibliography entries. The main narrative and section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds Table 8 and rearranges nearby appendix material. Earlier Tables 8–9 become Tables 9–10, and Figures 7 and 8 now share a page. Existing figure graphics and table designs are retained, with minor caption editing and local layout changes.

improvement.justification: Appendix B.3 and Table 8 strengthen empirical support beyond the earlier Qwen-only model experiments by testing an instruction-tuned Llama model. The gain is limited: results are modest and mixed, uncertainty estimates remain absent, and the warmup revision is unexplained. This targeted generalization evidence improves the paper slightly without substantially changing its established method or conclusions.
